plan.environment: the same grey-walled dining hall in the morning: one long wooden table down the left side with brown chairs and children's drawings along it, barred windows on the left wall, a tiled counter with a steel cooking pot on the right, a bright open doorway at the far end

panels.video_beat: the crayon boy leans in from his seat beyond Maria to look at her glowing drawing, curious, his hands on the table edge, while Maria scribbles on

the boy gives a small shrug, loses interest, sits back and turns to his own sheet to draw his green dinosaurs; Maria, chin up and smiling proudly, looks toward the open floor where MACA waits; the camera eases back slightly and settles
